description: Active Enyo NNUE improvement-run config. This file is the reviewed source of truth for the current candidate recipe.
experiment: Reckless lane conservative check-state output buckets
goal: Retest the same small existing-weight check-state output-bucket delta with a lower LR/shorter fit after the first run improved non-mate targets but failed mate-like tails.

required_before_training: engine builds with ENYO_ENABLE_CHECK_BUCKET_NNUE=OFF and ON
copied-head bucketed net loads and is parity with the single-head net
evalnet bench shows no normal-build overhead and acceptable enabled overhead
required_before_sprt: static gate is not worse than reference on broad validation
composite move-choice gate does not show a tactical-tail collapse
mate-like and mined SPRT-failure slices do not regress
SPRT only if cheap gates are clean
